admission.justification: The member boundaries together protect the end-to-end promise: a concern alone cannot constrain writes or remediation, and a slot guard alone cannot preserve request/report identity and primary-chat ownership.

guarantee: A supplied concern may be investigated across source, task, memory and provider evidence, with checks confined to scratch or repository tooling sandbox; its report reaches the actual starter before any explicitly ordered provider/system remediation, while no order grants code, memory, task or role-start authority.
title: One scoped investigation produces a report without acquiring leaf mutation authority
